# Agent Relay

> Agent Relay is a free and open source handoff layer for AI work. It helps people move work between humans, AI agents, and systems without losing the source, limits, status, or receipt.

## Canonical Site

- [Agent Relay site](https://the-little-ai-company.github.io/agent-relay-site/): Marketing and method site for Agent Relay.
- [The method](https://the-little-ai-company.github.io/agent-relay-site/method/): Overview of the relay method and its core guides.

## Method Guides

- [The Relay Loop Audit](https://the-little-ai-company.github.io/agent-relay-site/method/relay-loop-audit/): Nine checks for whether a handoff can leave the chat.
- [Prompt Craft](https://the-little-ai-company.github.io/agent-relay-site/method/prompt-craft/): The progression from prompt to handoff-ready task.
- [The 30-Minute Relay](https://the-little-ai-company.github.io/agent-relay-site/method/thirty-minute-relay/): A six-block setup flow for a first relay.

## Source Code

- [Agent Relay kit](https://github.com/The-Little-AI-Company/open-work-relay): CLI, templates, adapters, protocol, and local dashboard.
- [Agent Relay website](https://github.com/The-Little-AI-Company/agent-relay-site): Source for this static Astro site.

## Use Notes

Agent Relay is MIT licensed. The core concept is that work should travel as a task record with an outcome, owner or next actor, source material, context, allowed actions, stop rules, and done evidence.
